about: Real places near those colleges in Ahmednagar (Ahilyanagar) district, Maharashtra, built 2026-09-24, extended 2026-10-04 with stationery, xerox and printing shops, CSC centres, eateries and other daily-needs shops. Imported by `npm run db:import:ahmednagar`. Nothing here is invented; see each record's source.
